headline: EPACK Prefab Technologies commences commercial production and operations
hook: New revenue streams open at EPACK Prefab
summary: EPACK Prefab Technologies Limited has officially started commercial production and operations, as notified to the stock exchange. The commencement marks the operational transition of its manufacturing facilities. Indian retail investors tracking the company can evaluate future quarterly earnings for contributions from this new capacity.
whats_next: Next quarterly financial results reflecting production revenues
why_it_matters: New plant revenues will reflect in upcoming quarterly results.

headline: EPACK Prefab Technologies announces new capacity addition
summary: EPACK Prefab Technologies Limited has officially informed the stock exchange about a capacity addition. The company has not provided financial details, timelines, or production volumes associated with this expansion. Investors should note this procedural disclosure as a preliminary corporate update. This operational change has limited immediate impact on retail portfolios.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate update with no immediate financial impact.

headline: EPack Prefab Technologies accepts resignation of Company Secretary Preeti Chauhan
hook: Routine secretarial exit at EPack Prefab
summary: EPack Prefab Technologies announced the acceptance of resignation of its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Preeti Chauhan. The filing marks a routine managerial change in the company's secretarial department. Such departures of compliance officers are standard procedural updates for listed and pre-listed entities. The news carries no direct financial impact for retail investors holding the stock.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your investment in the company

headline: Preeti Chauhan resigns as Company Secretary of EPACK Prefab Technologies
hook: Compliance officer steps down at Epack Prefab
summary: EPACK Prefab Technologies Limited has informed the stock exchanges that Ms. Preeti Chauhan has resigned from her position as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. Her resignation becomes effective on October 14, 2026. The company has not yet named a successor to take over the compliance role.
whats_next: Appointment of a new company secretary and compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no immediate financial impact on investors
